title.zh: 微软补齐语音Agent全链路：边说边转写，语音生成低至45ms
title.en: 微软补齐语音Agent全链路：边说边转写，语音生成低至45ms

current_state.zh: Microsoft AI released three audio models — MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming for real-time 60-language transcription and MAI-Voice-2.1 / 2.1-Flash for text-to-speech with latency as low as 45ms — aimed at making low-latency voice agents feasible.
